name: ChangeColumnSecurityLevel

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the tenant ID, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户的 ID。

鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户 ID。具体操作，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The database ID. The database can be a physical database or a logical database.

The ID of a physical database: You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the physical database ID.
To obtain the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
数据库 ID（DatabaseId），数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：

物理库 ID：可通过调用 ListDatabases (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listdatabases) 或 SearchDatabase (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-searchdatabase) 接口获取该参数的值。
逻辑库 ID：可通过调用 ListLogicDatabases (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listlogicdatabases) 或 SearchDatabase (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-searchdatabase) 接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database
false: The database is a physical database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库是否为逻辑库，取值：

true：逻辑库。
false：物理库
parameters.name: is_logic

parameters.help_en:
The database name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to query the database name.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to query the name of a physical database and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to query the name of a logical database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。可调用ListSensitiveColumns (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listsensitivecolumns)或SearchDatabase (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-searchdatabase)接口获取该参数的值。

您可以调用  ListDatabases (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listdatabases) 接口获取物理库的 SchemaName 值，调用 ListLogicDatabases (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listlogicdatabases)接口获取逻辑库的 SchemaName 值
parameters.name: schema_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation to query the table name
parameters.help_zh: 表名。可调用ListSensitiveColumns (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listsensitivecolumns)或ListTables (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listtables)接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the field. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141870.html operation to query the column name
parameters.help_zh: 字段名。可调用ListSensitiveColumns (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listsensitivecolumns)或ListColumns (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listcolumns)接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: column_name

parameters.help_en: The new security level of the column. The valid values are the same as the sensitivity levels of the classification template that is associated with the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2539519.html operation to obtain the sensitivity levels of the classification template
parameters.help_zh: 字段新的安全级别，安全级别取值范围为实例绑定的分类分级模板的敏感序列。您可以调用ListSensitivityLevel (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dms/developer-reference/api-dms-enterprise-2018-11-01-listsensitivitylevel)接口来获取模板的敏感序列列表
parameters.name: new_sensitivity_level
